crossRefs.note: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes…
For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no…

translations.web: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
translations.bsb: The light in his tent grows dark, and the lamp beside him goes out.
translations.kjv: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out
translations.asv: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp above him shall be put out.
